We need to book a flight. Steps: get flight cost in USD, then convert to EUR. Then book flight. We have card id card_7243, access token abc123xyz. Travel details: from San Francisco to Rome on 2026-10-10 business class.

First get flight cost: get_flight_cost with travel_from: SF? Actually list_all_airports includes names like San Francisco. But get_flight_cost expects travel_from as 3-letter code. For San Francisco likely SFO. For Rome likely FCO (Rome–Fiumicino). So we call get_flight_cost with travel_from="SFO", travel_to="FCO", travel_date="2026-10-10", travel_class="business". Then compute_exchange_rate from USD to EUR. Then book_flight with card_id "card_7243" etc. Let's do that.
